title: Trends over time
text: Series over categories, numbers, or dates, with gaps for missing values and an optional area fill.

title: Zoom and crosshair
text: Zoom and pan along the x axis with a toolbar, keys, wheel, or drag, plus an optional crosshair.

title: Keyboard points
text: One tab stop; arrow keys move between points and show the tooltip on focus.

title: Data table fallback
text: A generated summary and a table with the exact values for screen readers.

title: Not color alone
text: Series differ by color, marker shape, and dash pattern.
